Foinn Seisiún tune index

A searchable, unofficial index of all 328 tunes in Foinn Seisiún (Session Tunes) books 1–3 from Comhaltas Ceoltóirí Éireann, compiled by Brian Prior — the sets of favourite session tunes many Irish music classes learn from. Each tune shows its book and page; sort by book order to see the sets as printed.

Sheet music and playback use the first setting on thesession.org, so details may differ from the book.
